title: Coach without a cab
why: The cab limits are for units fitted with a cab.

noise.cab_standstill_horn_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): has_drivers_cab is false, so there is no cab to limit.
